case.background: A spring is loaded slowly enough that inertia and hysteresis can be ignored. Determine how its equilibrium extension depends on applied force and the spring's calibrated stiffness setting.
initial_observations: The unloaded spring returns to the same reference position after each trial.
Changing the applied force produces a reproducible change in extension.

controls.description: Calibrated stiffness label of the installed spring.
controls.name: spring_stiffness_n_per_m

instruments.description: A calibrated quasistatic loading frame with interchangeable springs, a force setting, and an extension gauge.
instruments.name: spring_extension_rig

notes: This is a deterministic idealized benchmark world, not a literal replay of a historical data table.
A valid experiment changes only listed controls and consumes one episode attempt.

FinalSubmission.model must equal 'expression'. FinalSubmission.parameters must equal {'outputs': {READOUT: EXPR, ...}} with exactly these readouts: extension_cm. EXPR is the shared family-neutral JSON arithmetic tree over public controls. Supported operators are: add, subtract, multiply, divide, power, negate, exp, log, sin, maximum, step. No candidate law family or truth-specific parameter slots are supplied.

readouts.description: Equilibrium extension from the unloaded position.
readouts.name: extension_cm

case.title: Discover the load-extension relation
